notes.title: Game Version 1.20 Major Update
notes.notes:
Thanks to all the curators and players who have supported the game, Thank you! If you encounter any problems in the game, please contact the developer directly or refer to the video posted by the developer on Youtube or steam community. Simply search for the game name: Dreamland.

This major update will unlock the fourth area of the game as planned: the Chasm of Darkness, while releasing the final boss and the final plot of the game as well. The specific updates are as follows:

[h1] Open the Chasm of Darkness Region [/h1]
Defeat Boss Fear in the Sea of Fear and jump from the abyss to reach it. Release the boss Dark Twin,  as well as over 10 new monsters/animals, and corresponding resources/craft recipes, etc. Add 6 new achievements related to the fourth region.

[h1] Final Boss Battle [/h1]
After defeating all four regional bosses, you can reach it from the Dream Altar. Defeating the boss will trigger the final plot, and there will be different endings based on the previous game progress.

[h1] Modification of minor content [/h1]
Some monsters, objects, and some visuals adjustments.

The game has been updated to version 1.2. 

And welcome to my upcoming new game:)

notes.title: Game Version 1.1 Major Update
notes.notes:
The game has been released for one month already. Its graphics is rough, its gameplay is slow-paced and lack of hint, and it is crazy difficult for beginners. Thank you very much for the players who still adhere to it! If you encounter any problems in the game, please contact with me directly, via my email or leave post on forum, or you can refer to the videos I posted on forum.

This major update will unlock the third area of the game as planned: the Sea of Fear, as well as some improvements on game features such as the numerical values, graphics, and controls. The details are as follows:

[h1]Unlock the Sea of Fear[/h1] 
Players can reach the Sea of Fear from the Vortex after defeating Boss Pride. There are 9 scenes of Dune Sea of Desperation and 9 scenes of Sea of Fear, plus boss scenes, a total of more than 20 scenes.  4 boss monsters including boss fear, more than 20 types of monsters/animals, as well as corresponding resources/craft recipes. Unlock the 3rd instance in the Gobi Desert of the Dune Sea: Nightmare Painting. Add 10 new achievements related to the Sea of Fear.

[h1]Game Features [/h1]
Add a fast item equipment slot, which can be quickly used in battles with the middle mouse button. Add an accessory equipment slot,(necklace etc., and light sources such as lantern and torches can be equipped here to provide light sources, no longer occupying the auxiliary hand slot). Minor adjustments to the mechanisms of range weapons, now it is slightly more convenient to switch to shooting and sniping. Adjustments have been made to buildings such as shrimp trap and bread oven, including an increase in output rate and modifications to their upgrades.

[h1] Game Graphics[/h1]
I have made some modifications to the graphics of character, some game objects, and UI. I hope they can be more beautiful, perhaps... :)

The game has been updated to version 1.1 now, which requires an additional 20 hours to complete. Thank you for tolerating such a crude game. It's been a lot of effort!
